title: Greenland's ice vanished 416,000 years ago, and ancient sediment reveals why
description: Ancient sediment from beneath Greenland's ice reveals how much warmer summers were 416,000 years ago, offering new clues about the ice sheet's future.

title: Paleontology Dead Dinosaurs Rising
description: The only thing rising from the dead this Friday the 13th is the dinosaurs! Join esteemed paleontologist Robert Gastaldo for a presentation about his work, stories about dig sites, fossil research, and the methods used to reconstruct prehistory. This event is hosted in collaboration with the Illustration Institute in conjunction with the Illustrasaurus: The Dinosaur Art Show for the Eons on display in the Lewis Gallery October - December.

title: Ancient Egyptian mummies never gave ‘informed consent’ before death, so museum removes them
